lead_story.topic: Guardians complete comeback from 0-2 to eliminate White Sox in ALDS Game 5 — Gavin Williams 12 SO, José Ramírez go-ahead HR, 21 strikeouts set playoff record
lead_story.headline: GUARDS BALL LIVES

tweets.text: The Cleveland Guardians come back from down 0-2 and advance to the ALCS!
The Guardians are the first team to comeback from down 0-2 in a Division Series since they lost to the Yankees in 2017

DOWN 0-2. NOW HEADED TO THE ALCS. 🔥

The Guardians complete the comeback against Chicago, sending the White Sox home and extending their winless streak in winner-take-all postseason games. 😤

lead_story.research_notes: CONTINUING [Day 8, TIER 1 ELIMINATION GAME — FLOOR OF LEAD]. Cleveland came back from 0-2 series deficit per ground truth, first team to do so in Division Series since they lost to Yankees in 2017 per TalkinBaseball. Gavin Williams: 5.2 IP, 1 H, 0 ER, 2 BB, 12 SO — first Guardians pitcher with 12+ SO in postseason game since Charles Nagy 1996, 24 SO in series most since Gerrit Cole 25 in 2019 ALDS per StatMuse/TalkinBaseball. José Ramírez go-ahead 2-run HR in 5th was 100-mph blast off Sean Burke per JomboyMedia/TalkinBaseball — Spanish broadcast call available per JomboyMedia, Travis Kelce fired up watching per JomboyMedia. White Sox struck out 21 times (playoff record) per JeffPassan/CespedesBBQ, 75 SO in series most in 5-game series in MLB history per TalkinBaseball. Erik Sabrowski escaped bases-loaded jam striking out Murakami per TalkinBaseball. Cade Smith 5-out save per TalkinBaseball. Burke wore black Air Force 1s on mound per JomboyMedia. Guardians advance to ALCS vs Rays per JeffPassan. White Sox 0-1 (.000) when striking out 21+ times per JayCuda. Stephen Vogt in locker room: 'We've got 8 more wins to go' per ClutchPoints. ANGLE: This is a comeback story (0-2 to 3-2), a pitching dominance story (Williams, 75 SO in series), a clutch hitting story (Ramírez HR), and a meme story (Burke's Air Force 1s, JayCuda's uniform tracker, 'GUARDS BALL LIVES'). The strikeout record is absurd — 21 in a single game, 75 in a five-game series. The Spanish call of Ramírez's HR is electric. Kelce's reaction is viral. This is the upset that keeps giving.
lead_story.gif_concept: Smug vindication after being doubted — down 0-2, told they were finished, now they're in the ALCS
lead_story.meme_concept: White Sox struck out 75 times in five games, the most in a five-game series in MLB history. They were swinging at everything and hitting nothing. Classic 'expanding brain' escalation: first rung is normal strikeout rate, fourth rung is 'just close your eyes and swing.'

beats.landing: The reader realizes Williams is a postseason ace, and Cleveland's pitching is historically elite

beats.landing: The reader hears the call, sees Kelce's hype, and feels the moment that broke the game open

beats.landing: The reader laughs at the absurdity, and understands Cleveland won by simply not swinging and missing

tweets.text:
No. 2 Georgia holds on to beat No. 6 Alabama!

It’s the Bulldogs first win at Alabama since 2007 😮
WHAT AN ABSOLUTELY GLORIOUS WIN FOR KENTUCKY
Dijon Lee punching a Georgia player twice after a play is objectively the dumbest play a college player has made since Marco Wilson throwing a shoe.
Big Balls Will Stein! Kentucky does it again.

supporting_stories.research_notes: Oklahoma beat No. 1 Texas 27-24 per ground truth — Arch Manning INT with 20 sec left per ESPN/BallsackSports, Sooners kicked game-winner per SportsCenter. First win over Texas since 2023 per ground truth. Georgia beat No. 6 Alabama 20-17 per ground truth — controversial no-call on pass interference in final minutes sparked outrage from Kalen DeBoer per CBS Sports/JomboyMedia/HaterReport, Dijon Lee personal foul punching Georgia player twice after play cost Alabama the game per RedditCFB/HaterReport ('objectively the dumbest play since Marco Wilson throwing a shoe'). Kentucky beat No. 10 LSU 35-34 in OT per ground truth — Will Stein big-balls call, kicker missed 26-yarder to send to OT per BarstoolReags, Lane Kiffin left field surrounded by middle fingers per JomboyMedia. UCLA beat No. 13 Oregon 17-15 per ground truth — Bruins now 5-0, 5 straight wins (last 5+ within season 2022), beat Oregon for first time since 2017 per ground truth. ANGLE: This is the most chaotic Saturday of the season. Four ranked teams lost, all on controversial or bizarre plays. Dijon Lee's punch is the new shoe throw. The no-call in Bama-Georgia is going to be argued about for years. Kentucky's kicker missing from 26 yards is a meme. Arch Manning threw a pick with the game on the line. UCLA is 5-0 and nobody saw it coming. The SEC is eating itself alive. Georgia is the new No. 1. Texas stumbles. Oregon's CFP hopes crater. The Big 12 is suddenly in play for multiple bids. This is the weekend that broke the playoff bracket.
